content.title: The Eden Bazaar
content.text:
The Eden Bazaar is now officially open and ready for business.

Built to bring our player-driven economy together in one place, the Bazaar is a dedicated medieval trading city featuring 42 shop plots, giving players the opportunity to establish their own stores and become part of our growing marketplace.

Take some time to explore the city, wander through its streets, check out the available plots and see what other survivors have to offer.

If you find a plot you like, don’t hesitate to apply and make it your own.

To do so you will need to head over to our community website https://arkprojecteden.com and fill in the application form providing the street address of the shop plot you'd like to claim.

The Bazaar is located on The Island map, coordinates: 88.2 / 89.7 (Herbivore Island).

content.title: Gen 1 Ascension Race
content.text:
The first tribe to ascend on Alpha difficulty will receive:

• A personal Gas Vein at their base
• A personal Oil Vein at their base
• A personal Water Vein at their base
• 10,000 Shop Tokens

The first solo player to ascend will also receive the same rewards.

Good luck to everyone taking on the race!

content.title: Gen 1 Rules
content.text:
• To keep the map enjoyable for everyone and avoid overcrowding in the smaller biomes, we ask that all tribes place their main base in the Ocean biome. The other biomes should be used for your single allowed 4x4 outpost only.
• This helps ensure more players can have viable outposts in the limited land biomes.
• Any builds exceeding this limit will be removed. If your tribe goes over the limit, the smallest bases will be destroyed first.
• No building in mission zones.
• Do not block the Outpost Islands that spawn in the Ocean biome.
• One shipyard per tribe.
• One market per tribe.

These rules apply to the Genesis 1 VIP map as well.

content.title: Account Linking
content.text:
Link your in-game survivor to unlock the full experience.

How to Link:
1. Go to https://ezclaps.co.uk/ and log in with Steam, Epic or EOS
2. In-game type: !getconnectcode (twice) or use /connect in #bot-commands
3. Paste the code on the website under Settings → Alternative Connect Methods
4. Connect your Discord on the same page

Once linked you will get the Beach Bob role and access to most channels.

Register your tribe on Discord as soon as possible!

content.title: How to Access the Shop
content.text:
How to Open the Shop:

• In-game: Radial Menu → GSA → Shop (Or press F6 on PC)
• You can also use the shop directly on our Community Website.

Useful Bot Commands (in #bot-commands channel only):
• /claim → Claim tokens after voting
• /votelist → Show vote list
• /connect → Link your account
• /pay → Send tokens to another player
• /players → List online players
• /servers → Check server status

content.text:
Tokens are the main currency. They are transferable between players.

Survivor 5% → Hunter 10% → Pathfinder 15% → Beastmaster 20% → Alpha 25% → Apex Legend 30%

content.title: General Rules
content.text:
• No hate speech, harassment, or toxic behaviour.
• Hacks, dupes, exploits, or third-party tools that provide an unfair advantage will result in a ban.
• Do not intentionally interfere with another player's gameplay or progression.
• Do not deliberately provoke, obstruct, or disrupt other Survivors.
• Report exploits to the Admin Team instead of abusing them.
• Trapping other players is considered trolling and is not permitted.
• Do not steal eggs or unclaimed babies belonging to other Survivors.
• Please do not direct message Admins with questions that can be answered in general chat or through a support ticket.

content.title: Building & Breeding
content.text:
Help keep the server smooth and enjoyable for everyone. Build, breed and decorate with the performance of the cluster in mind.

1. There is no strict base size limit, but don't go overboard. Use only the space you actually need and be prepared to downscale if requested by the Admin Team.
2. Where possible, build outside the render distance of other tribes.
3. Collect your taming traps and remove temporary structures once they are no longer needed.
4. We strongly encourage the use of the Propagator for breeding. It exists to reduce server load and eliminate the need for large outdoor breeding lines.
5. If you choose to breed manually without the Propagator, you may have a maximum of 40 breeding dinos out at one time.
6. Tames left breeding while you are offline may be redgunned by Admins to reduce server load.
7. Use cryopods or dino balls to store excess creatures. If your base is causing excessive lag, Admins may ask you to cryo some tames. You are expected to comply.
8. Do not build on player spawn locations. Trapped players will be freed and offending structures may be removed.
9. Do not block mission terminals, obelisks, boss zones, explorer notes, major resource locations or important player access points.
10. Decor and building mods should be used with moderation.
11. Excessive decorations, structures or light sources can cause lag and crashes. Prioritise performance over unnecessary decoration.
12. Do not spam foundations or pillars simply to claim land.
13. Take down unused pens, starter huts and abandoned structures.
14. Excessive gates may be removed. Where possible, use Plant Species X, turrets and dino leashes instead of large walls and gate systems.
15. Turrets used for base defence should be set to Wild Dinos Only.
16. Turret boxes at Wyvern trenches will be removed immediately.
17. Gas and Oil Pumps must remain unlocked and available for public use.

content.title: Tribe Rules
content.text:
• Your tribe name must be the same on every server across the cluster.
• Character names must not use Human as a name.
• Each tribe may have one main base per map, plus one small outpost of no more than 4×4 foundations.

content.title: Replacement Policy
content.text:
We do not replace items or dinos lost due to normal gameplay, including:

• Deaths, including AFK, dehydration or starvation.
• Normal gameplay risks or player negligence.
• Lost or despawned death bags.

We do have an Inventory Backup Saver and may be able to recover and replace items lost due to:

• Bugged death bags.
• Server crashes or unexpected disconnects.
• Other game bugs or glitches that result in item loss.

Recovery is only possible when the necessary backup data is available and an Admin is available to assist. Please open a support ticket with as much information as possible when reporting a loss caused by a technical issue.
